prompt: Build a modular Automated Stock Portfolio Rebalancing Engine in C# structured into: (1) Market Data Feed Subsystem ingesting live asset prices, (2) Portfolio Optimization Calculator computing target asset allocation weights against risk parameters, and (3) Trade Execution Subsystem generating buy/sell orders.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Feed Score: 0-5 (Evaluates price stream ingestion and thread safety)
Module 2 Optimizer Score: 0-5 (Evaluates mathematical portfolio weighting calculations)
Module 3 Execution Score: 0-5 (Evaluates order generation and rounding edge cases)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates portfolio consistency and timing control)
